calls.title: Mark: Jennifer
calls.summary: The team discussed the need for department-level cost breakdowns on invoices to improve expense allocation amid recent growth, particularly in marketing. Mark highlighted the challenges posed by current invoices not separating costs by department and advocated for detailed itemizations to make processing easier. Historical expense allocation will be approximated to balance accuracy with workload, prioritizing timely insights. Jennifer was tasked with opening a support case to investigate invoice discrepancies and explore customization options. A clear cost model timeline was established, with internal deadlines set to prepare for the upcoming board meeting, emphasizing the urgency for vendor support responses. While initial manual allocations raised uncertainties, there was a commitment to improving visibility and confidence in cost reporting through collaboration and timely updates.
calls.keywords: Invoice allocation, Department costs, Support case, Contractor payments, Financial modeling, Board meeting deadlines
calls.action_items:
**Jennifer**
Open a support case to investigate discrepancies in invoice transactions, memo mismatches, and explore the feasibility of invoicing by department (02:28)
Provide updates to Mark on the progress and timeline of the support case resolution (07:00)

**Mark Beltran**
Continue initial cost allocation for past invoices using approximate methods while awaiting support feedback (06:13)
Complete the financial model by Friday the 5th and coordinate handoff to internal team for forecasting updates before the board deck deadline on Friday the 12th (05:30)
